rowReasons.reason: survives every stage; an unrouted connection is reported per net, never hidden
survives; a class whose members differ is routed at the most restrictive member's values (never relaxed)
survives for the board-wide through-via policy; blind / buried / micro vias have no representation here (directive section 9)
check-only: the router is not told; a violation surfaces after import and the candidate stays unproven for that net
check-only: a per-net layer restriction is found after routing, not obeyed during it
survives for the represented stackup; dielectric / material data has no field in BoardStackup (thickness only), so no impedance-bearing stackup fact exists
unsupported for autorouted copper: a required routing keepout is an explicit limitation of the FreeRouting path until the writer carries it and DRC checks it
survives conservatively: the router may route up to the edge; the edge-clearance violation is caught by DRC and the candidate stays unproven
placement-only: proved at placement by the hard validator (a soft objective otherwise); the router can neither honour nor violate it
placement-only for the footprint distance; the routed-copper separation is the next row
unsupported: a required analog routing separation is an explicit limitation of this path (a wider class clearance for the net is the qualified alternative)
advisory-only: a loop requirement is placement evidence, never a routed proof (not EMI, current-capacity or PI proof)
placement-only: side and orientation are hard-checked; the edge distance itself is advisory
scope-only: priority is realized as routing scope and sequence, never as a rule the router enforces
unsupported: a required return-path constraint is an explicit limitation of this path
unsupported: a required differential coupling is an explicit limitation of this path
check-only: skew is measured after routing (static length), never obeyed during it
unsupported: a required impedance is an explicit limitation of this path
